heading: Step 1: Make a page
body:
Start in the folder that `ty init my-app` made on the Install page. For this guide, keep the default answers (press Enter for each question), so the app has pages and a server in JavaScript. A page is a `tac.html` file in `client/pages`. Its folder is its URL, so `client/pages/hello/tac.html` is the page at /hello. A component is a part of a page that you can use again. The folder `client/components/hello/card` becomes the tag `<hello-card>`.

Run `ty preview` in the project folder, and keep it running while you follow the steps. It builds the app again each time you save a file. When `ty preview` starts, it checks that every public method has a test. The project from `ty init` already has its tests, and step 5 adds the tests for the classes that you add. Open the address that `ty preview` prints, and add /hello at the end.

Result: the page shows the heading Hello and the text This is my first page.
